g.text: Topic = eventType(): the record's simple name in kebab-case,
Key = partitionKey(): every record overrides it (shown as
"key:" on each record). Records carry data only — no Spring,
no JPA, no behaviour beyond derived accessors.
reason : String {the rule, or a refusal code}
The key choice is deliberate: the seat topics and
session-capacity-changed share sessionId so the RT1
fill-rate join needs no repartition; the saga topics
share registrationId so one registration's messages
stay in order; the ticket topics use ticketCode.
